messages.update_available_message: A new version of the app is available. Some features may not work correctly until you update.
messages.greeting_with_name: {timeOfDay, select, morning {Good morning, {name}} afternoon {Good afternoon, {name}} evening {Good evening, {name}} night {Good night, {name}} other {Hello, {name}}}
messages.greeting: {timeOfDay, select, morning {Good morning} afternoon {Good afternoon} evening {Good evening} night {Good night} other {Hello}}
messages.username_format: Only letters, numbers, underscores and dots are allowed
messages.enter_code_sent_to_email: Enter the code we sent to {email}
messages.scan_code_or_enter_code_manually: Scan their QR code, or enter their code manually.
messages.camera_access_needed_to_scan_code: Camera access is needed to scan a code.

onboarding.title: Permissions
onboarding.description: Pavé works better with a few permissions - all optional, and you can change them anytime in Settings.
onboarding.permission_denied_hint: You declined this permission. You can try again, or manage it later in Settings > Permissions.

permissions.location_reason: To show reports near you and place yours on the map.
permissions.bluetooth_reason: To relay reports to the server when you have no internet connection.
permissions.notifications_reason: To alert you about approvals and trusted-contact updates.
permissions.camera_reason: To scan a QR code when adding a trusted contact.
permissions.location_consequence: Reports you create won't be placed at your current location on the map automatically.
permissions.bluetooth_consequence: The mesh relay won't be available, so your reports can't reach the server without an internet connection.
permissions.notifications_consequence: You won't get push alerts for approvals, trusted-contact updates, or other account activity.
permissions.camera_consequence: You won't be able to scan a QR code to add a trusted contact.
permissions.background_location_reason: Records your trajectory during a protest even when the app is closed.
permissions.background_location_consequence: Protest mode can only record while the app is open.

complete.description: Pick a username to finish setting up your account.

welcome.description: We've picked a username for you - keep it, or make it yours.

recovery_phrase.title: Recovery phrase
recovery_phrase.description: This 24-word phrase is a backup way back into your account if you ever lose every device - it works immediately, without needing your trusted contacts. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe. It will not be shown again.
recovery_phrase.confirm_label: I've saved this phrase somewhere safe
recovery_phrase.finish_confirm_message: Once you continue, this phrase will never be shown again - not on this device, not on any other, and not even by contacting support. If you haven't written it down or saved it somewhere safe yet, go back now.

device.title: New device
device.body: A new device wants access to your recovery key. Only approve this if you recognize it.
device.location_approximate: Approximate location, based on IP address
device.approve_confirm_message: It will be able to receive a copy of your recovery key.

recovery_request.title: Recovery request
recovery_request.body: {ownerName} lost access to all their devices and is asking you, as a trusted contact, to help them recover their key.
recovery_request.approve_confirm_message: This can't be undone. Only do this if you're sure it's really {ownerName} asking.

own_device.title: Waiting for approval
own_device.body: This device is waiting for one of your other devices to approve it before it can receive your recovery key.

recovery.start: I don't have access to any of my other devices
recovery.start_confirm_message: This permanently removes every other device from your account and asks your trusted contacts to help you recover access instead. This can't be undone.
recovery.no_contacts: You'll need at least one accepted trusted contact before you can recover access this way.
recovery.title: Recovery in progress
recovery.delay_body: For your security, your trusted contacts' responses won't be usable until {releaseAt}.
recovery.waiting_shares_body: Waiting for enough of your trusted contacts to respond.
recovery.cancel_confirm_message: Your trusted contacts will be notified that this is no longer needed.
recovery.impossible: Not enough of your trusted contacts can still approve this request. Cancel it and start a new one.

mnemonic.start_confirm_message: Your other devices will be suspended immediately and will need to be re-approved (via another active device, this phrase, or your trusted contacts).
mnemonic.title: Enter your recovery phrase
mnemonic.description: Type the 24 words you saved when you first set up your account, separated by spaces.
mnemonic.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid recovery phrase - check the words and try again.
mnemonic.wrong_phrase: That phrase doesn't match this account.

data_access_request.title: Access request

owner.title: {requesterName} is asking to read your recordings
owner.waiting_body: {approved} of {required} of your other trusted contacts have approved. If you do nothing, {requesterName} can read your protest recordings from {releaseAt}.
owner.open_body: {requesterName} can read your protest recordings until {expiresAt}. Refusing closes that now.
owner.refuse_confirm_message: {requesterName} will not be able to read your recordings. Do this if you did not expect the request.
owner.dismiss_hint: Closing this changes nothing - the request carries on. You can still refuse later from Settings › Recovery.

data_access_request.body: {requesterName} is asking to read {ownerName}'s protest recordings - usually because they can't be reached. Approving releases the share you hold, and a majority of {ownerName}'s other contacts has to do the same. {ownerName} can still refuse during a waiting period.
data_access_request.approve_confirm_message: This hands {requesterName} a piece of what unlocks {ownerName}'s recordings. Only do it if you are sure {ownerName} would want it.

recovery.active_body: This device already has access to your recovery key.
recovery.declined_body: This device's request was declined, or it was removed from your account. Register it again to ask once more.

settings.sign_out_pending_message: {count, plural, one {You have 1 change that hasn't reached the server yet.} other {You have {count} changes that haven't reached the server yet.}} Signing out now loses it for good.

trusted_contacts.revoke_confirm_message: They will no longer be part of your trusted contacts.

share.description: Show this QR code, or share the code below out loud or by text.

devices.revoke_confirm_message: It will stop receiving updates to your recovery key.

mesh_relay.title: Mesh relay
mesh_relay.footer_description: When enabled, this device relays safety reports to and from other nearby devices over Bluetooth, so reports can still reach the server even when this device - or one relaying for it - has no internet connection. Only works while the app is open.
mesh_relay.permission_denied_message: Pavé needs Bluetooth permission to relay reports between nearby devices. You can grant it in your device settings.
mesh_relay.permission_hint: Bluetooth permission needed to relay reports. Manage it in Permissions.

protest_mode.title: Protest mode
protest_mode.gps_recording_description: Whether a session records where this phone goes.
protest_mode.gps_interval_description: More often is more precise and uses more battery. A protest lasts hours.
protest_mode.sync_interval_description: The most recording a phone taken from you could still be holding.

access.request_body: If {ownerName} can no longer get at their own recordings - detained, or their phone gone - you can ask to read them. A majority of {ownerName}'s other contacts has to approve, and {ownerName} can refuse during a waiting period.
access.request_confirm_message: {ownerName} will be told immediately, and so will their other trusted contacts. Only ask if they really cannot do it themselves.
access.waiting_body: Even with enough approvals, {ownerName} can refuse until {releaseAt}.
access.lone_contact: You are {ownerName}'s only other contact, so nobody has to approve - the waiting period until {releaseAt} is the only thing left.
access.cancel_confirm_message: It disappears from everyone's screen. You can ask again later.
access.combine_failed: Access is open, but no key for these recordings reached this device.

closed.failed: Too few of {ownerName}'s other contacts approved your last request.
closed.expired: Your last access window has closed.

report.title: What's happening?
report.no_location: Can't get your location - try again in a moment.

protest_mode.title: Protest mode
protest_mode.gps_recording_description: Uses location in the background while a session is open.
protest_mode.stop_confirm_message: The session will be closed. Anything already recorded stays on this device and keeps uploading in the background.
protest_mode.permission_denied_message: Without "Always" location, the trajectory stops being recorded as soon as you leave the app.
protest_mode.sign_in_required: Sign in to record a session.
protest_mode.no_dek_title: This device cannot protect a recording yet
protest_mode.no_dek_message: Your account has a recovery phrase but this device does not hold the key — a reinstall clears it. Enter your recovery phrase here once, then start a session.
protest_mode.conflict_message: Another session is still open on your account and could not be closed from here. Reconnect and try again.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. Start one from protest mode.
sessions.pending: {count, plural, one {# not sent} other {# not sent}}
sessions.audio_gaps: Recorded in segments, so each one is safe on the server before the next starts. The short gaps between them are real.
sessions.no_key: No key for this recording on this device

protest_mode.microphone_denied_message: Without it there is nothing to record. Grant access, then tap again.
protest_mode.gps_off_hint: Trajectory recording is off — turn it on in protest-mode settings.
